If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
Once your cancellation is confirmed, we issue the refund immediately to your original payment method. The time it takes to appear depends on your bank or payment provider:
• Card payments: usually 3–5 business days (some banks can take up to 10 business days).
• Digital wallets (e.g., Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal): often 1–3 business days.
You’ll receive a confirmation email as soon as the cancellation goes through.

• Place a new order with all the items you want in one go.
• If your existing orders haven’t entered preparation or dispatch, I can try to cancel them so you can reorder as a single shipment (not guaranteed due to timing).
If you’d like me to try cancelling the existing order(s), please share:
• Both order numbers (or the ones you want cancelled)
• The postcode on the orders
